headline: Regional school officials approved a revised budget decreasing Southborough's assessment, while the Affordable Housing Trust advanced a new senior housing zoning proposal.
synopsis: The Northborough-Southborough Regional School Committee approved a revised $31.52 million FY27 budget, slightly reducing Southborough's assessment due to increased state Chapter 70 aid. Meanwhile, the Affordable Housing Trust advanced a draft 55-plus housing zoning bylaw and transferred approximately $1 million in idle funds to an interest-bearing account. Municipal technology officials reviewed promotion for the ongoing resident satisfaction survey and prepared for an upcoming municipal phone system migration. Additionally, the Trails Committee outlined grant outreach for 2027 trail funding and discussed roadway crossing options.

highlights.title: Revised FY27 Regional School Budget Approved
highlights.why: The committee re-voted the $31.52 million budget to reflect an additional $104,890 in Chapter 70 state aid, reducing Southborough's assessment to $10,731,901.

highlights.title: Senior Housing Zoning Bylaw Draft Advanced
highlights.why: The trust agreed on a draft bylaw allowing up to eight units per acre on two-acre parcels with a 12.5 percent affordability mandate, eliminating the town-wide 7 percent elderly unit cap.

highlights.title: Housing Trust Balance Moved to Interest Account
highlights.why: Approximately $1 million previously sitting in a non-interest-bearing account was shifted to an insured savings program expected to generate about $35,000 annually.

highlights.title: Outreach Begins for 2027 MassTrails Grant
highlights.why: The committee initiated preparations to pursue a state grant of up to $100,000, focusing on curriculum partnerships with Southborough and Framingham schools.

highlights.title: Resident Satisfaction Survey Promotion and Phone Upgrade
highlights.why: The committee developed plans to boost survey participation before the late-November deadline and confirmed municipal offices will cut over to cloud-based phones on November 13.
